facts.fact: On 28 November 2025 the president of Guinea's Haute Autorité de la Communication announced to media heads a formal ban on all media, including their social-media channels, broadcasting speech or images generated by artificial intelligence during the presidential election campaign; the article gives no sanction schedule and reports it as announced at a briefing.
facts.system: HAC ban on AI-generated content in election campaign coverage
